channel.title: Biomes on Core Keeper Hub
channel.description: Recent content in Biomes on Core Keeper Hub

item.title: Azeos' Wilderness
item.description: Azeos’ Wilderness is the lush forest outer-ring biome, mined for Scarlet Ore. Caveling Gardeners and Bush-disguised Caveling Hunters roam with Purple Slimes, Azeos the Sky Titan awaits ~600 tiles out, and Mold dungeons infect parts of it. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: Breaker's Reach
item.description: Breaker’s Reach is the mechanical, void-tainted late-game biome found far north past The Passage, added in the Void & Voltage update. It yields Relucite Ore and Corrupted Alloy and is overrun by Geobots and void cavelings. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: Forlorn Metropolis
item.description: The Forlorn Metropolis is a ruined hi-tech dungeon scattered through The Sunken Sea. Caveling Scholars support the heavier Core Sentries here, and the ruins hold Octarine Ore and materials for the Phantom Spark. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: Larva Hive Biome
item.description: The Larva Hive Biome is a maze-like dungeon inside The Clay Caves, its walls made of tough organic Larva Hive Block. Slimes do not spawn here; instead Chrysalis and acid-laying larvae are everywhere, and The Hive Mother waits at its heart. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: Mold Biome
item.description: The Mold Biome is a fungus-overrun dungeon embedded in Azeos’ Wilderness. Mold Ground slows you by up to 75% at ten stacks, and the zombie-like Infected Cavelings plus stunning Mold Tentacles make it one of the hardest areas in the game. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: Molten Quarry
item.description: The Molten Quarry is a volcanic sub-biome of The Desert of Beginnings, its blackened terrain split by lava and burning Ground Magma Slime. It is home to Igneous the Molten Mass and the Ancient Forge needed for the Soul Seeker Pickaxe. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: The Clay Caves
item.description: The Clay Caves is one of the two inner-ring biomes (150–450 tiles from the Core), home to the game’s tin ore and the Larva Hive dungeon where the Hive Mother waits. Location Cross the chasm around The Undergrounds with a Wood Bridge. The Clay Caves and The Forgotten Ruins each occupy one half of the world beyond the chasm — the exact angle varies by seed, so if you find the Ruins first, walk the opposite direction from the Core.

item.title: The Desert of Beginnings
item.description: The Desert of Beginnings is the hot sandy outer-ring biome, mined for Galaxite Ore. Explosive Bomb Scarabs and swift Caveling Assassins patrol, Ra-Akar the Sand Titan waits ~1000 tiles out, and Molten Quarry and Oasis sub-biomes are hidden among the sandstone. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: The Forgotten Ruins
item.description: The Forgotten Ruins is the stone inner-ring biome opposite The Clay Caves, mined for Iron Ore and Gold Ore. Cavelings defend their settlements here on Stone Moss, and Malugaz the Corrupted is summoned in the throne room around 350 tiles from The Core. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: The Great Wall
item.description: The Great Wall is an unbreakable wavy barrier spanning 450–520 tiles around the inner biomes. It gates access to the outer biomes until you have powered up The Core and unlocked the ability to break it down. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: The Passage
item.description: The Passage is the outermost biome beyond the three outer rings, its fossil-block walls needing late-game mining gear. It yields Pandorium Ore and is home to Sulfur Worms and Urschleim, the optional late-game slime boss circling ~1250 tiles out. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: The Shimmering Frontier
item.description: The Shimmering Frontier is a bright blue crystal ring wrapped around the outer biomes. It is the source of Solarite Ore, Gleam Wood and the colored gems, patrolled by Crystal Snails, Mimites and Orbital Turrets. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: The Sunken Sea
item.description: The Sunken Sea is the water-filled outer biome of Beach Sand islands and glowing crystal water, mined for Octarine Ore. Tentacles, Blue Slimes and Bubble Crabs apply a slippery debuff, Omoroth lurks ~1100 tiles out, and Forlorn Metropolis dungeons sit among the islands. Tips Data sourced from the Core Keeper wiki (atma.gg); numbers shift with patches Bring appropriate resistance gear before farming this area

item.title: The Undergrounds
item.description: The Undergrounds (the Dirt Biome) is the safe starting ring around The Core, spanning 0–140 tiles. It is also the default biome filling the gaps between other biomes. What you find Copper and tin ore for the first tools Wood, stone and early food crops The first three bosses’ summon points at fixed arcs Tips Build your first base within 140 tiles of the Core for safety Follow Ghorm’s track to explore outward efficiently
